lastCompletedStory.title: Review round 1 fix 002: address reviewer finding

nextStoryContext: US-R1-002 fixes Resend API key security: (1) readResendConfig now prefers RESEND_API_KEY env var (canonical, not git-tracked), falls back to resend_api_key in [notify] project.toml for backward compat; (2) cam init/runSetup no longer writes resend_api_key to the git-tracked project.toml; resend_recipient (non-sensitive) is still persisted; (3) warnIfResendUnconfigured hint updated to reference RESEND_API_KEY env var; (4) stale comments in sidecar.ts and loop.ts updated. Resend official docs confirm RESEND_API_KEY is the canonical env var name.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Resend docs confirm RESEND_API_KEY is the canonical env var name; docs explicitly recommend against hardcoding API keys. Our implementation matches exactly.
